entries.title: Spoiler warnings on posts and comments
entries.description: Mark a post, comment, or forum post as a spoiler and add a short note about what it spoils. Others see the warning first and choose when to reveal it.

entries.title: Bookmark posts
entries.description: Save posts to read later and find them again in the new Bookmarks tab on your home page, where you can also search through them.

entries.title: Explore and community pages in the mobile app
entries.description: Search for communities, see who's in them and which friends have joined, open community pages, and join from your phone.

entries.title: Settings in the mobile app
entries.description: Change your theme, NSFW, privacy, update notes, guided tours, and connected accounts right from the mobile app, just like on the web.

entries.title: Add Orbis to your home screen
entries.description: On your phone, Orbis offers to install itself on your home screen so it opens full screen like any other app.

entries.title: MyAnimeList and Steam links on media pages
entries.description: Anime, manga, and game pages now link to the matching MyAnimeList or Steam page so you can jump straight there.

entries.title: Smoother loading when you open Orbis
entries.description: A loading screen with tips shows while your feed, friends, and communities load, and pages show placeholders instead of jumping around as they fill in.

entries.title: Library status shows while it saves
entries.description: When you change an entry's status in your library, the button shows it's saving until the change goes through.

entries.title: Mobile theme follows your account
entries.description: The theme you pick in the mobile app is saved to your account and applied when you sign in, the same as on the web.

entries.title: No more Upcoming list for manga
entries.description: The media shelf no longer shows an Upcoming list for manga, where it didn't apply.
